blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in paraphrase detection reveal a fundamental trade-off: large language models achieve high accuracy but require high computation, while efficient Siamese-BERT variants offer practical scalability with reduced transparency in rationale generation. We present R-DEIM Net, a 76M-parameter dual-expert architecture exploring whether moderate-scale models can achieve competitive accuracy on paraphrase detection while enabling human-readable rationale generation. The architecture combines two specialized components: an Interaction Expert that captures token-level similarity patterns through multi-scale 2D convolutions and attention head allowing variable input length, and a Reasoning Expert that uses a Flan-T5-small decoder to generate rationales as auxiliary supervision. Rather than re-encoding generated text, we extract and pool decoder hidden states as complementary features for classification. On the Quora Question Pairs dataset, R-DEIM Net achieves 90.07% accuracy and 90.16% F1-score via 10-fold cross-validation. This represents competitive performance with strong transformer-based baselines (e.g., MFAE BERT: 90.54% accuracy) and recent large language model based approaches (LLaMA-70B) while using a substantially smaller parameter budget. The model generates rationales alongside predictions, providing potential for auxiliary human-readable descriptions.
blocks.zh: 最近在解码检测方面的进步揭示了一个根本性的权衡:大型语言模型实现了高精度,但需要高计算,而高效的暹罗-BERT变体则提供了实用的可伸缩性,在原理生成方面透明度降低. 我们提出R-DEIM Net,这是一个76M参数的双专家架构,探讨中度模型是否能够在解码检测上实现竞争性的精度,同时能够产生人可读的理由。 该架构结合了两个专业部分:一个是交互式专家,通过多尺度的2D演化和注意力头来捕捉符号级相似性模式,允许可变输入长度;另一个是理性专家,使用Flan-T5小解码器来生成原理作为辅助监督. 而不是重新编码生成的文本,我们提取和集合解码器隐藏状态作为分类的补充特征. 在Quora Question Pairs数据集上,R-DEIM Net通过10倍的交叉验证实现90.07%的精度和90.16%的F1分. 这代表了具有强变压器基线(如MFAE BERT: 90.54%的精确度)和最近大型语言模型基于方法(LLaMA-70B)的竞争性性能,同时使用的参数预算要小得多. 该模型与预测同时产生原理,为辅助人类可读描述提供了潜力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurately discerning semantic equivalence between text segments for paraphrase detection is a cornerstone of modern Natural Language Understanding (NLU) ( Gali et al., 2016 ; Srivastava and Govilkar, 2017 ) . This capability is critical for applications ranging from intelligent search and conversational AI to content de-duplication ( Hammer and others, 2023 ) and plagiarism detection ( Kauchak and Barzilay, 2006 ; Callison-Burch et al., 2006 ; Iordanskaja et al., 1991 ; Duboue and Chu-Carroll, 2006 ; Riezler et al., 2007 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Following the 2017 Kaggle competition ( DataCanary et al., 2017 ) , the Quora Question Pairs (QQP) dataset has become the standard benchmark for this task, requiring models to capture semantic identity across diverse surface-level wordings ( Bernardi et al., 2013 ; Vahtola et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 准确辨别文字段之间的语义等同,用于解说检测是现代自然语言理解(NLU)的基石(Gali等人,2016年;Srivastava和Govilkar,2017年). 这一能力对于从智能搜索和对话AI到内容去重复(Hammer等人,2023年)和盗版探测(Kauchak和Barzilay,2006年;Calison-Burch等人,2006年;Iordanskaja等人,1991年;Duboue和Chu-Carroll,2006年;Riezler等人,2007年;Zhou等人,2025年)等应用至关重要。 2017年卡格尔竞技(DataCanary et al., 2017)之后,Quora Question Pairs(QQP)数据集成为这一任务的标准基准,要求模型在不同的表层语言中捕捉语义特征(Bernardi et al., 2013;Vahtola et al., 2022).

blocks.en: Recent progress in paraphrase detection reveals distinct trade-offs between competing objectives. High performance is achieved by Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Han and others, 2025 ) and ensemble BERT ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) , but these models result in high computational costs limiting real-world deployment. Conversely, efficient Siamese-BERT architectures ( Mahmoud and Zrigui, 2022 ; Cheng and Gangaraju, 2023 ) achieve practical scalability but provide only binary predictions with limited transparent rationale generation. While attention mechanisms can partially address this gap in mathematical aspect, most efficient paraphrase detection systems still lack explicit, rationales explaining their decisions in human-readable format.
blocks.zh: 最近在解释性检测方面取得的进展表明,相互竞争的目标之间有着明显的取舍。 高性能由大语言模型(LLMs)(Han等,2025年)和综艺BERT(Zhang等,2020年)实现,但这些模型导致高计算成本限制现实世界部署. 相反,高效的暹罗-BERT建筑(Mahmoud and Zrigui, 2022年;Cheng and Gangaraju, 2023年)实现了实用的可伸缩性,但仅提供了二进制预测,其透明原理生成有限. 虽然关注机制可以部分解决数学方面的这一差距,但最有效的解码检测系统仍然缺乏明确的理由,以人可读的格式解释其决定.

blocks.en: To explore whether moderate-scale models can achieve competitive accuracy while providing synthetic rationale generation, this paper introduces R-DEIM Net (Rationale-Augmented Dual-Expert Interaction Model). R-DEIM Net takes a sentence pair as input and outputs a binary classification alongside generated text rationales. The architecture combines two complementary experts: (1) an Interaction Expert that captures token-level similarity patterns through multi-scale 2D convolutions and attention-based pooling to handle variable-length inputs, and (2) a Reasoning Expert that uses Flan-T5-small decoder to generate rationales as auxiliary training supervision. The Reasoning Expert’s hidden states during rationale generation act as a feature vector complementing the interaction patterns for final classification.
blocks.zh: 为了探讨中尺度模型能否在提供合成原理生成的同时达到竞争精度,本文引入了R-DEIM Net(理由增强双专家互动模型). R-DEIM 维基月球在线解说-DEIM Net将一对句子作为输入,并输出一个二进制分类和生成的文本理由。 该架构结合了两位互补专家:(1)互动专家通过多尺度的2D演化和基于注意力的集合来捕捉象征级相似性模式,处理可变长输入;(2)理性专家使用Flan-T5小解码器来生成原理作为辅助培训监督. 理性专家的隐藏状态在原理生成过程中起到一种特征载体的作用,补充了最终分类的相互作用模式。

blocks.en: The primary contributions are as follows: • We propose R-DEIM Net, a dual-expert framework that jointly models token-to-token interactions and generative reasoning signals for paraphrase detection. • We design an interaction expert that uses 2D convolutions and an attention-based pooling strategy to efficiently capture token alignment patterns from variable length sentence pairs. • By using decoder hidden states from a generative model as latent reasoning features, we adopt a mechanism that grounds classification decisions in natural language features without re-encoding generated rationales, which avoids unnecessary computational overhead and additional encoding layers. • We present a thorough empirical analysis to show how interaction and reasoning components contribute to semantic decision-making, including structural alignment, kernel activation behavior, and POS-based perturbation.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献如下: 我们提议建立R-DEIM Net,这是一个双重专家框架,它联合模拟符号对脚的相互作用和基因推理信号,用于解释性检测。 我们设计了一个互动专家,使用2D演化和基于注意力的集合策略,从可变长度的句子对中有效捕捉到符号对齐模式. ^ 通过使用基因模型中隐藏的解码态作为潜在推理特征,我们采用了一种机制,在自然语言特征中为分类决定提供依据,而无需重新编码产生的理由,从而避免不必要的计算间接费用和额外的编码层. ^ . 我们提出了透彻的经验分析,以显示互动和推理组件如何促进语义决策,包括结构对齐,内核激活行为,以及基于POS的扰动.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Paraphrase detection on the Quora Question Pairs (QQP) dataset has evolved from traditional lexical features to deep sequential architectures and, recently, to massive LLMs. This progression reflects a shift from manual feature engineering toward automated semantic representation, which requires trade-offs in efficiency and transparent rationale generation.
blocks.zh: 在Quora Question Pairs(QQP)数据集上的参数检测从传统的词典特征发展到深层次的顺序架构,最近又发展到大规模的LLMs. 这一进展反映了从人工特性工程向自动语义表达方式的转变,这要求在效率和产生透明理由方面作出权衡。

blocks.en: Early methodologies relied on manual feature engineering and basic vectorization, with accuracies typically ranging from 63% to 85%. Sharma et al. (2019) demonstrated that a simple Continuous Bag of Words (CBOW) model achieved 83.4% accuracy, while Ansari and Sharma (2020) reached 82.44% using 28 hand-crafted features with an XGBoost classifier. Similar lexical strategies were explored in ABCNN ( Yin et al., 2016 ) , PWIM ( He and Lin, 2016 ) , and the “cascadedCN” model ( Korade et al., 2024 ) . Techniques like Lexical Decomposition and Composition (LDC) ( Wang et al., 2016 ) and Syn-tree ( Chen et al., 2017 ) attempted to capture alignment by breaking sentences into primitive components. While computationally light, these methods are limited by the inability to capture deep semantic context or complex word-order dependencies.
blocks.zh: 早期方法依靠人工特征工程和基本矢量化,精度一般在63%至85%之间. 夏尔马等人(2019年)证明,一个简单的连续袋(CBOW)模型实现了83.4%的精度,而安萨里和夏尔马(2020年)则使用28个手动特性并带有XGBoost分类器达到了82.44%. 在ABCNN(Yin等人,2016年),PWIM(He和Lin,2016年)以及“cascadedCN”模式(Korade等人,2024年)中也探讨了类似的词汇战略。 诸如LDC(LDC)(Wang等人,2016年)和Syn-tree(Chen等人,2017年)等技术试图通过将句子破解成原始组件来捕捉对齐. 虽然在计算上轻而易举,但这些方法却因无法捕捉到深语义上下文或复杂的词序依赖而受到限制.

blocks.en: The shift toward neural sequence modeling introduced RNN and CNN-based frameworks, yielding accuracies between 79% and 89%. Convolutional approaches, such as Siamese-CNN and MP-CNN ( Wang et al., 2017 ) , utilized spatial filters to identify local n-gram similarities. Concurrently, recurrent models like Siamese-LSTM, MP-LSTM ( Wang et al., 2017 ) , and ESIM ( Chen et al., 2017 ) focused on long-range dependencies. Universal encoders like InferSent ( Conneau et al., 2017 ) and GenSen ( Subramanian et al., 2018 ) sought general representations, while SSE ( Nie and Bansal, 2017 ) , CAS-LSTM, and Bi-CAS-LSTM ( Choi et al., 2019 ) introduced stacked architectures to refine context. Performance boundaries were further pushed using Bi-LSTM and attention framework by Faseeh et al. (2026) . This model leveraged SMOTE ( Chawla et al., 2002 ) for augmentation, despite prevailing concerns that oversampling in the feature space may fail to preserve semantic validity in textual representations ( Blagus and Lusa, 2013 ; Taskiran et al., 2025 ) . Concurrent systems like pt-DecAtt ( Tomar et al., 2017 ) and LSTM+ElBiS ( Choi et al., 2018 ) demonstrated similar gains in predictive power. However, these models often struggle with variable-length inputs and lack transparency in decision-making logic.
blocks.zh: 向神经序列建模的转变引入了基于RNN和CNN的框架,其速率在79%至89%之间. 演化方法,如暹罗-CNN和MP-CNN(Wang等人,2017年),利用空间滤波器来识别本地n-g的相似性. 同时,Siamese-LSTM,MP-LSTM(Wang等人,2017年),ESIM(Chen等人,2017年)等反复出现的型号都专注于远程依赖. InferSent(Conneau等人,2017年)和GenSen(Subramanian等人,2018年)等通用编码器寻求一般性表述,而SSE(Nie and Bansal,2017年),CAS-LSTM,以及Bi-CAS-LSTM(Choi等人,2019年)则引入了堆叠式架构以完善上下文. Faseeh等人利用Bi-LSTM和关注框架进一步推进了性能界限(2026年)。 这一模型利用SMOTE(Chawla等人,2002年)进行扩充,尽管人们普遍担心,在特征空间进行过度取样可能无法在文字表述中保持语义有效性(Blagus和Lusa,2013年;Taskiran等人,2025年)。 pt-DecAtt(Tomar等人,2017年)和LSTM+ElBIS(Choi等人,2018年)等同时期系统在预测功率上表现出类似的收益. 然而,这些模型往往与可变长的投入发生矛盾,决策逻辑缺乏透明度.

blocks.en: To capture complex semantic interactions, models operating over dense interaction spaces were developed, with accuracies now reaching the 88% to 90% range. DIIN ( Gong et al., 2017 ) and Multiway Attention Networks (MwAN) ( Tan et al., 2018 ) utilize sophisticated attention to align sentence pairs. The integration of ensemble BERT led to MFAE ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Brahma, 2018 ) and CDTFME-Aver ( Xie et al., 2019 ) , which leverage BERT and ELMo embeddings. At the extreme scale, the most recent model, LLaMA-70B, is applied by Han and others (2025) .
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉复杂的语义相互作用,开发了在密集的相互作用空间上运行的模型,现在的敏锐度达到了88%到90%的范围. DIIN(Gong等人,2017年)和多路关注网络(MwAN)(Tan等人,2018年)利用精密的注意力对齐句子对齐. 综艺BERT的整合导致MFAE(Zhang et al.,2020年;Brahma,2018年)和CDTFME-Aver(Xie et al.,2019年),它们带动了BERT和ELMo的嵌入. 在极端尺度上,最新的模型LLaMA-70B被汉人等人应用(2025年).

blocks.en: A critical analysis of existing literature reveals three primary deficiencies. First, a significant portion of prior work focuses almost exclusively on raw accuracy, frequently failing to report F 1 F_{1} -score, which leaves performance on imbalanced data unverified. Second, nearly all existing architectures rely on a fixed max_tokens limit. This forces a compromise between truncating semantically rich sentences or introducing excessive padding, both of which create sparse, inefficient matrices and noisy attention weights. Finally, despite their predictive power, these models provide binary labels.
blocks.zh: 对现有文献的批判性分析揭示了三个主要缺陷。 首先,前期工作相当一部分几乎完全侧重于原始准确性,常常没有报告F 1 FQQQ1} - 得分,这使得对不平衡数据的业绩得不到核实。 其次,几乎所有现存的建筑都依赖于固定的max_tokens限制. 这迫使人们在缩短内容丰富的句子或引入过量的加注之间达成妥协,两者都造成了稀疏,效率低下的矩阵和吵闹的注意力重量. 最后,尽管它们的预测力,这些模型提供了二进制标签.

Figure 1 illustrates our approach for this task to classify and provide rationale. In the following, we describe the individual component of this approach.

blocks.en: 3.1 Branch A: Interaction Expert
blocks.zh: 3.1 分支A:互动专家

blocks.en: This branch is designed to move beyond simple vector similarity and analyze token-to-token semantic relationships between the two questions. Both input questions are first processed by the shared encoder. To select the optimal encoder, several pre-trained encoders were evaluated (Table 1 ), and paraphrase-MiniLM-L12-v2 ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Korga et al., 2025 ) was selected. While models like TinyBERT achieved marginally higher raw metrics, MiniLM-L12 offers a superior trade-off, delivering competitive accuracy (88.42%) and F1-scores (88.56%) with a significantly lesser parameter ( ≈ \approx 33M).

blocks.en: This branch serves a dual purpose: it generates an explicit rationale for the model’s decision and converts the latent logic itself into a feature vector. Flan-T5-small decoder ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) is employed, where the token embeddings E Q ​ 1 E_{Q1} and E Q ​ 2 E_{Q2} from the shared encoder are provided as ‘encoder hidden states‘, giving the decoder full context. To bridge the dimension gap between the siamese encoder (384) and the T5 decoder (512), a simple linear projection layer is used.
blocks.zh: 这一分支具有双重目的:它为模型的决定提供了明确的理由,并将潜在逻辑本身转化为特征矢量。 Flan-T5-小解码器(Raffel等人,2020年)被使用,其中来自共享解码器的嵌入EQ 1 E_{Q1}和EQ 2 E_{Q2}的符号作为‘编码器隐藏状态'提供,给出解码器的完整上下文. 为了弥合暹罗编码器(384)和T5解码器(512)之间的尺寸差距,采用了简单的线性投影层.

blocks.en: During training, while generating a rationale the decoder is tasked with auto-regressive decoding with teacher forcing ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . Rather than re-encoding the generated surface text which would require passing the text through another encoder, adding unnecessary computational overhead and training complexity the sequence of decoder hidden states, H d ​ i ​ m H_{dim} , is directly extracted as each token is generated.This results in a variable-length tensor ( L × H d ​ i ​ m L\times H_{dim} ) representing the reasoning. Similar to Branch A, a separate ‘Attention Head’ is applied to pool this sequence into a single, fixed-size reasoning vector, v r ​ e ​ a ​ s ​ o ​ n ​ i ​ n ​ g v_{reasoning} .
blocks.zh: 在培训期间,在产生理由的同时,解码器的任务是与教师强迫进行自动递归解码(Vaswani等人,2017年)。 生成的表面文本需要通过另一个编码器将文本传送给另一个编码器,增加了不必要的计算间接费用和培训复杂性,而不是重新编码生成的表面文本,而是随着每个符号的生成,直接提取解码器隐藏状态的序列Hd i H_{dim}。 这导致一个可变长度的拉伸(L × H d i m L\times H_{dim}),代表推理. 类似于分支 A , 应用单独的“ 注意头” 来将这个序列集合成一个单一的, 固定大小的推理向量, v r e a s o n i n v {x_{ reasoning} 。

blocks.en: 3.3 Fusion and Multi-Task Training Objective
blocks.zh: 3.3 融合和多任务培训目标

blocks.en: The final classification combines insights from both experts. The two feature vectors are concatenated to form a final representation ( v f ​ i ​ n ​ a ​ l v_{final} ) containing both interaction patterns and generative logic which is passed through an MLP.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: This section presents the empirical evaluation of R-DEIM Net, including the experimental setup, comparative performance on the Quora Question Pairs (QQP) benchmark, and a multi-level analysis of model behavior. All experiments were conducted on a system equipped with an NVIDIA Quadro RTX 6000 GPU, 64 GB RAM, and an Intel Xeon CPU.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍对R-DEIM Net的实证评价,包括实验设置,Quora问题配对(QQP)基准上的比较性能,以及对模型行为的多层次分析. 所有实验都是在一个配备NVIDIA Quadro RTX 6000 GPU,64 GB RAM,以及Intel Xeon CPU的系统上进行的.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Evaluation was performed on the QQP dataset ( DataCanary et al., 2017 ) , consisting of 404,290 pairs. To train the Reasoning Expert, the dataset was augmented with synthetic rationales generated by an LLM using a few-shot Chain of Thought (CoT) prompt ( Wei et al., 2022 ) to ensure high-quality reasoning (Appendix A and D ). Following preprocessing, the final dataset comprised 400,520 annotated pairs.
blocks.zh: 对QQP数据集(DataCanary等人,2017年)进行了评价,共404,290对. 为了培训理性专家,用LLM生成的合成原理扩充了数据集,利用了几发的思维链(COT)提示(Wei等人,2022年),以确保高质量的推理(附录A和D)。 经过预处理,最后数据集包括400 520对附加说明的对子.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 R-DEIM Net Multi-Task Training with Decoupled Weight Decay
blocks.zh: 算法 1 R-DEIM 网络多任务培训与脱钩的重量衰减

blocks.en: R-DEIM Net employs a paraphrase-MiniLM-L12-v2 encoder (384-dim) and a Flan-T5-small decoder (512-dim), connected via a linear projection layer. The base Flan-T5-small model contains 77M parameters, split between a 35.3M parameter encoder and a 41.6M parameter decoder. Although these components are typically integrated, our architecture utilizes only the decoder for rationale generation, leaving the T5 encoder unused and excluded from the training process. Lightweight task-specific heads introduce fewer than 1M additional parameters. Specifically, the total parameter count includes the T5 decoder (41.6M), the MiniLM encoder (33M), and custom projection/attention heads ( ≈ \approx 1M), totaling roughly 76M parameters.
blocks.zh: R-DEIM 维基月球在线解说-DEIM Net使用一个解码器-MiniLM-L12-v2编码器(384-dim)和一个Flan-T5-小解码器(512-dim),通过线性投影层连接. 基础Flan-T5-小模型包含77M参数,在35.3M参数编码器和41.6M参数解码器之间划分. 虽然这些组件一般是集成的,但我们的架构只使用解码器来生成理由,使得T5编码器被闲置,被排除在培训过程之外. 轻量级任务专用头引入的附加参数少于1M. 具体来说,总参数计数包括T5解码器(41.6M),MiniLM编码器(33M),以及自定义的投影/注意头(QQ\\约1M),总计约76M参数.

blocks.en: Training was performed ( Algorithm 1 ) for a fixed number of epochs using AdamW optimizer ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with different learning rates Ilharco et al. (2023) for pre-trained and task-specific components. All architectural choices are summarized in Appendix C . The classification objective uses a weighted binary cross-entropy loss that explicitly penalizes false positives by assigning a higher weight to the majority non-duplicate class. This design encourages conservative duplicate predictions, ensuring that a sentence pair is labeled as Duplicate only when strong semantic evidence is present. Reproducibility is ensured through the use of standardized, publicly available pre-trained models and the explicit reporting of all training hyperparameters in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 使用AdamW优化器(Loshchilov和Hutter,2019年)为固定数量的时代进行了培训(Algorithm 1 ),Ilharco等人(2023年)的预训和任务特定组件的学习率不同. 附录C概述了所有建筑选择。 分类目标采用加权二进制横切损失,通过给大多数非重复类分配更高的权重,明确惩罚假阳性. 这种设计鼓励保守的重复预测,确保一对句子只有在存在强烈的语义证据时才被贴上重复的标签. 通过使用标准化的、公开的预先培训的模型和在附录C中明确报告所有培训超参数,确保可复制性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验结果

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the 10-fold cross-validation results. R-DEIM Net achieved an average F 1 F_{1} -Score of 90.16% and accuracy of 90.07%. This performance improves on the efficient baselines listed (e.g., Bi-LSTM ( Faseeh et al., 2026 ) ) and is within reported ranges for large LLMs in prior work ( Han and others, 2025 ) while being ≈ \approx 900x smaller. To ensure the integrity of the evaluation, primary sources of data leakage were investigated by performing the 10-fold cross-validation split prior to any preprocessing. This ensured that lexical statistics and rationale patterns from validation sets were never visible during training.
blocks.zh: 表2列出10倍的交叉验证结果。 R-DEIM 维基月球在线解说-DEIM 净成绩平均为F1 FQQQ1} - 得分90.16%,精度90.07%. 这种性能提高了所列高效基线(例如,Bi-LSTM(Faseeh等人,2026年)),而且大型LLMs在先前工作的报告范围内(Han等人,2025年),而其规模则在\\900x左右。 为确保评价的完整性,在进行任何预处理之前,通过进行10倍的交叉验证,对数据泄漏的主要来源进行了调查。 这确保了在培训期间始终看不到各种鉴定组的词汇统计和论证模式。

blocks.en: Crucially, the full R-DEIM Net outperformed the strong “Interaction-Only” baseline (Branch A only), which achieved 88.63% F 1 F_{1} and 88.51% accuracy. The addition of the Reasoning Expert (Branch B) provided a substantial +1.53% boost in F 1 F_{1} -Score. This confirmed that the generative “reasoning vector” captures semantic nuances that the interaction matrix alone misses, effectively replacing the need for manual feature engineering.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,完整的R-DEIM Net的绩效超过了强力的“互动-唯一”基线(只有Branch A),达到了88.63%的F 1 F_{1}和88.51%的准确度。 增加的理性专家(Branch B)在F 1 FQQQ1)中提供了大幅+1.53%的提升 - 得分数 这证实,基因“合理矢量”捕捉到单是相互作用矩阵缺失的语义细微差别,有效地取代了人工特征工程的需要。

blocks.zh: 表3:R-DEIM Net的转移学习结果.

blocks.en: 4.3 Transfer Learning Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 转移学习分析

blocks.en: To evaluate the generalization capabilities of R-DEIM Net, a transfer learning experiment was conducted on seven diverse datasets (Appendix B ) spanning community QA, paraphrase identification, and scientific entailment. First, the zero-shot performance of the QQP-trained model directly on these unseen datasets was evaluated, followed by task-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 为了评价R-DEIM Net的通用性能力,在涵盖社区QA、参数识别和科学内涵的7个不同的数据集(附录B)上进行了转移学习实验。 首先,对这些未见数据集上的QQP训练模型的零镜头性能进行了直接评价,之后进行了针对特定任务的微调.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes these results. In the zero-shot setting, R-DEIM Net demonstrated strong generalization on datasets semantically similar to QQP, such as SprintFAQ (98.15% F 1 F_{1} ) and SoDD (63.01% F 1 F_{1} ). This indicated that the interaction and reasoning patterns learned from general-domain questions transfer effectively to specific domains without weight updates.
blocks.zh: 表3总结了这些结果。 在零镜头设定中,R-DEIM Net在与QQP相似的数据集上表现出强烈的概括性,如SprintFAQ(98.15% F 1 F_{1})和SoDD(63.01% F 1 F_{1}). 这表明,从一般领域问题中汲取的相互作用和推理模式在不更新权重的情况下有效地转移到具体领域。

blocks.en: However, we acknowledge a performance gap on adversarial datasets like PAWS and MRPC in the zero-shot setting. These datasets are specifically designed with high lexical overlap but distinct semantics. We hypothesize that this performance degradation may stem from the Interaction Expert’s reliance on localized spatial alignments (e.g., diagonal interaction), which might be bypassed by such adversarial word-scrambling. While further empirical analysis is required to fully confirm this sensitivity to linguistic perturbation, it highlights a potential limitation of efficient spatial models compared to massive cross-attention LLMs.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们承认在零镜头设定中PAWS和MRPC等对抗数据集的性能差距. 这些数据集是专门设计的,其词典重叠度很高,但语义不同. 我们假设这种性能退化可能源于互动专家对局部空间对齐(如对角相互作用)的依赖,而这种对抗性的文字拼接可能绕过这种组合。 虽然需要进行进一步的经验分析,以充分确认这种对语言扰动的敏感性,但它突显了与大规模跨注意力LLMs相比,高效空间模型的潜在局限性.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning further unlocked the potential of the model. Across all datasets, significant performance gains with minimal training (2-4 epochs) were observed. For instance, performance on the challenging PAWS dataset, known for high lexical overlap but distinct semantics, improved from 53.54% to 67.97% F 1 F_{1} . Similarly, CQADupStack saw a jump from 39.24% to 80.32% F 1 F_{1} . These results confirm that while R-DEIM Net learns a robust general representation from QQP and remains highly adaptable to specialized nuances.
blocks.zh: 精细调整进一步解锁了模型的潜力. 在所有数据集中,都观察到通过最低限度的培训(2-4个世纪)取得显著成绩。 例如,在具有挑战性的PAWS数据集上的性能以高词性重叠但截然不同的语义著称,从53.54%提高到67.97% F 1 F_{1}。 同样,CQADupStack也看到了从39.24%跳到80.32%的F 1 F_{1}. 这些结果证实,虽然R-DEIM Net从QQP那里学到了强有力的总体代表性,但仍然高度适应于专门的细微差别.

blocks.en: 4.4 Architectural Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 建筑分析

blocks.en: To validate architectural choices, a multi-level analysis was conducted using 10,000 question pairs.
blocks.zh: 为了验证建筑选择,利用10,000个问题对进行了多层次分析。

This observation supports the inclusion of complementary architectural components, such as convolutional and reasoning branches, to handle semantically equivalent but non-aligned sentence pairs.

This indicated that the interaction expert adaptively leverages broader spatial contexts to find semantic matches when they are not diagonally aligned.

blocks.en: To identify linguistic components driving decisions, systematic masking was performed at both token and group levels for 1,000 question pairs.
blocks.zh: 为了确定驱动决策的语言成分,在符号和组位对1 000个问题对进行了系统的遮掩。

blocks.en: Impact of masking individual tokens is shown in Figure 3 . Content-bearing parts of speech, specifically Noun , Verb , and Adjective , induced the highest drops in local accuracy and the highest “flip rates.” In contrast, function words like Determiners and Auxiliaries showed minimal impact.
blocks.zh: 图3显示面具个人标志的影响。 语言中包含内容的部分,特别是名词、Verb和形容词,导致了当地准确度最高的下降和最高的“滑动率”。 相比之下,诸如确定者和辅助者等函数词显示的影响最小。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Token-level perturbation analysis. Content words (Nouns, Verbs) exert the strongest influence on model decisions.
blocks.zh: 图3:洞层扰动分析。 内容词(英语:Nouns, Verbs)对示范决定影响最大.

blocks.en: Figure 4 confirms this trend at the global level. Masking categories of content words led to significant degradation in F 1 F_{1} -score, whereas removing function words caused only marginal performance loss. This alignment between local sensitivity and global degradation provides evidence that R-DEIM Net’s predictions are grounded in deep semantic content rather than superficial syntactic artifacts.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
R-DEIM Net, a 76M parameter architecture, is presented to resolve the trade-off between massive “black box” models and efficient but less accurate alternatives. While recent work achieved high accuracy but poor F 1 F_{1} , R-DEIM Net achieved the best of both: 90.07% accuracy and 90.16% F 1 F_{1} -Score. Ablation results show that incorporating generative reasoning features (Appendix E ) yields a consistent improvement over a strong interaction-only baseline, indicating that latent decoder dynamics capture semantic distinctions beyond token interaction alone.
We further validated architectural choices through a multi-level architectural analysis, including structural interaction, CNN kernel activation patterns, and systematic token and POS-level perturbations. These analysis demonstrate that model decisions are driven by semantic content rather than superficial lexical overlap, providing empirical support for the proposed design.
blocks.zh:
R-DEIM 维基月球在线解说-DEIM Net是一个76M参数架构,用于解决大规模“黑盒”模型与高效但不太准确的替代品之间的权衡。 虽然最近的工作取得了很高的准确度,但F 1 F_{1},R-DEIM Net实现了最佳的:90.07%的精确度和90.16%的F 1 FQQ1} - Score。 校对结果显示,纳入基因推理特征(附录E)比仅强的相互作用基线得到持续改善,表明潜在的解码器动力学捕捉到的语义区分超出了象征性相互作用。
我们通过多层次的建筑分析进一步验证了建筑选择,包括结构互动、CNN内核激活模式以及系统化的符号和POS层扰动。 这些分析表明,示范决定是由语义内容驱动的,而不是肤浅的词汇重叠,为拟议设计提供了经验支持。

blocks.en: We will focus on three key areas. First, applying the R-DEIM architecture to other sentence-pair tasks like Natural Language Inference (NLI). Second, investigating transfer learning by testing zero-shot performance on other paraphrase datasets and exploring parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Finally, further miniaturizing the model by exploring distilled decoders to optimize the efficiency-to-performance ratio.
blocks.zh: 我们将侧重于三个关键领域。 首先,将R-DEIM架构应用于自然语言推论(NLI)等其他句派任务. 第二,通过在其他参数拼音数据集上测试零镜头性能,探索参数高效的微调,来调查转移学习. 最后,通过探索蒸馏解码器,进一步实现模型的小型化,以优化效率-性能比.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: A primary limitation is the use of synthetically generated rationales for the QQP dataset via a large language model. While necessary due to the infeasibility of manually annotating > > 400k pairs, this is not ideal compared to human-written ground truth (although our validation study in Appendix D indicates strong alignment with human reasoning). However, the strong performance suggests the reasoning vector remains a robust feature, opening avenues for research into whether smaller, human-annotated datasets could yield better results.
blocks.zh: 一个主要限制是通过大型语言模型使用合成生成的QQP数据集原理. 由于手动注释不可行而有必要 " > 400k对,这与人类书面地面真理相比并不理想(尽管我们在附录D中的验证研究表明与人类推理有很强的配合). 然而,强劲的性能表明推理载体仍是一个强有力的特征,为研究较小的、附加说明的数据集能否产生更好的结果开辟了途径。

blocks.en: Furthermore, while the reasoning vector functionally contributes to classification accuracy, we do not claim strict faithfulness. The generated surface text mimics the structure of LLM-generated rationales (via our training data) but does not definitively prove the model’s internal cognitive logic. The text serves as an auxiliary descriptive rationale rather than a guaranteed causal post-hoc explanation. Stronger validation of faithfulness remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 此外,虽然推理矢量在功能上有助于分类的准确性,但我们并不主张严格的忠诚。 生成的表面文字模仿了LLM生成的原理的结构(通过我们的训练数据),但并不能明确证明模型的内部认知逻辑. 该案文是一种辅助性说明性理由,而不是一种有保障的事后因果关系解释。 加强忠诚的验证仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: In alignment with established SOTA benchmarks on the QQP dataset ( Han and others, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2017 ) , the evaluation focuses on Pair-Level Generalization . While the QQP dataset contains recurring questions across unique pairs, this experimental design reflects real-world retrieval-based settings where a model must discern semantic identity within unique pair combinations. This approach ensures a direct and fair comparison with existing literature while maintaining high-precision requirements essential for practical duplicate detection.
blocks.zh: 与QQP数据集既定的SOTA基准(韩等,2025年;王等,2017年)一致,评价侧重于Pair-level Generation. 虽然QQP数据集包含跨独特对对的反复出现的问题,但这一实验设计反映了基于现实世界的检索设置,一个模型必须在独特的对对对组合中辨别语义特征. 这种办法确保与现有文献进行直接和公平的比较,同时保持对实际重复检测至关重要的高精度要求。

blocks.en: In this study, computational efficiency and accessibility were prioritized. Experiments were conducted using base-models. While larger models (e.g., RoBERTa-large) might yield incremental performance gains, they require significantly higher VRAM and training time, which were outside the scope of the current hardware infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 这项研究将计算效率和可获取性列为优先事项。 利用基准模型进行了实验。 虽然较大的模型(如RoBERTa大型模型)可能会产生增量的性能增益,但它们需要显著增加的VRAM和培训时间,而这些时间超出了目前硬件基础设施的范围.

blocks.en: Appendix D Semantic Consistency and Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录D 语义一致性和人文评价

blocks.en: To validate the semantic consistency of the synthetically generated rationales, an embedding-based alignment experiment was conducted. Question pairs were concatenated using a separator token (i.e., Q1 + [SEP] + Q2 ) and processed through a pre-trained encoder ( paraphrase-MiniLM-L12-v2 ) to obtain unified pair embeddings. An identical encoding operation was performed on the LLM-generated “Final Comment” rationales. We then computed the cosine similarity between the question pair embeddings and their corresponding rationale embeddings. For correctly matched pairs, the mean cosine similarity was 0.5670. To establish a baseline, rationales were also paired with randomly selected question pairs, which caused the mean similarity to drop sharply to 0.0662. This distinct margin confirms that the generated rationales are highly specific and semantically grounded in their respective input pairs and not relying on generic formulations.
blocks.zh: 为了验证合成产生的理由的语义一致性,进行了嵌入式对齐实验。 问对采用分隔符符(即Q1 + [SEP] + Q2 )进行调和,并通过预训编码器(parape-MiniLM-L12-v2)进行处理,以获得统一的对嵌. 在LLM生成的“最后评论”原理上进行了同样的编码操作。 然后,我们计算出问题对嵌入及其相应原理嵌入之间的余弦相似性。 对于正确匹配的对子,平均余弦相似度为0.5670. 为了建立基线,原理也与随机选题对对对对,这导致平均相似度急剧下降到0.0662. 这一显著的比值证实,所产生的理由非常具体,以各自的输入对为基础,不依赖通用配方。

blocks.en: Additionally, a human evaluation study was conducted with 12 annotators on a subset of over 170 randomly selected pairs to verify the quality of the generated text. Annotators were tasked with providing “ground-truth” reasoning for the semantic relationship between the questions. These human-written rationales were then compared against the model-generated rationales using embedding similarity. The results demonstrated strong alignment, yielding a Spearman Correlation of 0.814 and a Cosine Similarity of 0.763. The descriptive depth was also comparable, with an average token length of 24.50 for human-written rationales and 28.02 for the Gemini-generated rationales.
